build_SECONDFPN: build a SECONDFPN neck module for 3D detection models like SECOND or PointPillars
create_SECONDFPN_with_custom_channels: create a SECONDFPN with custom in_channels and out_channels for multi-scale feature fusion
run_SECONDFPN_forward: run the SECONDFPN forward pass on multi-scale 4D feature tensors to get concatenated outputs
test_SECONDFPN_init_weights: test the SECONDFPN init_weights method to verify Kaiming and constant initialization
review_SECONDFPN_deblocks: review the SECONDFPN deblocks ModuleList that combines upsample layers with normalization and ReLU
